title: Hardcore IndieWeb: Run your own website 100% independently for only $0.01/day
summary: A technical guide on building and hosting a fully independent personal website using the IndieWeb principles, achieving a cost of just $0.01/day through free-tier services and open standards.
problem_solved: Enables individuals to own their online presence and content without depending on centralized social media platforms.
why_valuable: Provides complete data ownership and platform independence at near-zero cost while maintaining professional web presence.
